name: obsidian-mcp-server
description: Streamable HTTP MCP server for a persistent Obsidian vault.

scripts.build:web: esbuild frontend/app/core/app.js frontend/app/features/editor/editor.js frontend/app/features/reader/reader.js frontend/app/publish.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outdir=src/app/assets --entry-names=[name] --asset-names=fonts/[name]-[hash] --loader:.woff=file --loader:.woff2=file --loader:.ttf=file && esbuild frontend/app/features/reader/mermaid-runtime.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=src/app/assets/mermaid.js && esbuild frontend/app/features/canvas/canvas.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=src/app/assets/canvas.js && esbuild frontend/app/features/bases/kanban-runtime.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2020 --outfile=src/app/assets/kanban.js
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:architecture
